name: Open Natural Turn
notes: Owner's description (2026-11-16): the box-turn-like figure after the Promenade Chassé. Steps as the box turn's forward half: forward on the right, side on the left, close the right (not the American-style open ending, which passes back on 3). The couple turns a quarter to the right from the line joining the partners, gradually across all three steps, and the partners turn to face each other on count 2; no rise. Three counts, ending in closed hold with another figure to follow. Named as the figure that takes a natural turn out of promenade; the closing on 3 is the owner's, as in the International Natural Turn. Turns: the couple's quarter is spread evenly, 30 degrees (1/12) a step; closing the V adds an eighth on count 2 (the lead right, the follow left). So the lead turns 1/12, 5/24 and 1/12 to the right (3/8 in all, from facing 315 to 90) and the follow 1/12 right, 1/24 left and 1/12 right (an eighth in all, from 225 to 270); they face each other from the end of count 2. Sizes: the lead's right foot comes from behind along the line of travel and lands about 0.46 past his left (1.0 travelled); his left lands 0.4 to the side of it once turned; then he closes. The follow is on the inside of the turn, so her steps are smaller: her left goes 0.6 along the line, her right lands to stay in hold, and she closes. Offsets to the millimetre where the closed-hold check needs them.
